record_title: Pairwise independence does not preserve Lorden's mean-overshoot bound
provenance: An explicit finite-field counterexample testing whether Lorden's classical mean-overshoot constant survives replacement of mutual independence by pairwise independence.
limitations: The sequence is pairwise independent and identically distributed but not claimed to be strictly stationary. The result disproves the classical marginal-only constant under pairwise independence; it does not identify an optimal pairwise-independent bound or address stronger dependence conditions.
